The '''''Star Wars: Jedi''''' series of comics was published by [[Dark Horse Comics]] from August 20, [[2003]] to July 21, [[2004]] as a series of one-shots chronicling the actions of five [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
